title: Omix Task
description: Agent task definition for the Omix Builder AI workflow system. Tasks represent units of work that AI agents or human developers execute to build or modify the project. Example: { id: 'task_001', title: 'Add login form', type: 'feature', status: 'pending' }

description.description: Detailed task description with context and requirements.

type.description: Type/category of work. feature=new capability, fix=bug fix, refactor=restructure, style=visual/CSS, test=testing, docs=documentation, chore=maintenance, research=investigation, design=visual design, integration=connect systems.

status.description: Current task status in the workflow.

dependencies.description: Task IDs that must be completed before this task can start.

affectedScreens.description: Page IDs affected by this task. References page ids from the project.

affectedComponents.description: Component IDs affected by this task.

met.description: Whether this criterion has been satisfied.

acceptanceCriteria.description: List of acceptance criteria that must be met for task completion.

input.description: Estimated input token count for AI processing.

output.description: Estimated output token count for AI generation.

assignee.description: Agent or user ID assigned to this task.

labels.description: Labels/tags for categorization. Example: [frontend, urgent, auth]

notes.description: Additional notes or context for the agent.
